name: premilume
description: A user-controlled, skills-only workflow that balances direct answers with guided exploration.

interface.longDescription: A user-controlled workflow that selects direct answers, guided exploration, or a concise blend based on the user's goal, urgency, learning intent, uncertainty, risk, and reversibility. It supports per-request overrides, keeps important assumptions and value choices visible, and adds no external server, account, long-term memory, or telemetry. Its roles are response strategies, not separate agents or professionals.
defaultPrompt: $premilume-mode 멘토 모드를 켜고 이 설계의 전제와 가장 작은 검증 실험을 함께 찾아줘.
$premilume-mode Turn mentor mode on and help me solve this while preserving the key reasoning.
$premilume-mode 멘토 모드를 켜고 이번 요청은 직접 답변으로 처리해줘.
